metric_input: Unquantized clamped CUDA RGB and canonical raw RGB resized with production PIL policy
PSNR: utils.image_utils.psnr on [1,3,H,W], global RGB MSE, max intensity 1
LPIPS: lpips 0.1.4, VGG, version 0.1; normalize RGB [0,1] to [-1,1]
figures_predefined_views: Sorted frozen validation views at indices 0, floor(N/2), N-1
independent_spatial_ROI: Fixed central rectangle above; descriptive only, not guaranteed foreground
predicted_ROI: Frozen B_R0 validation mask shared by every treatment; descriptive proxy only, NOT independent GT
predicted_ROI_resize: PIL nearest to actual render dimensions
background_contamination_proxy: Mean rendered RGB energy/alpha outside frozen R0 predicted ROI
holes_proxy: Fraction alpha < 0.5 inside frozen R0 predicted ROI; NOT true geometric holes
independent_GT_policy: Only calculate independent silhouette/Boundary-F1 if held-out manual contours with verified camera identity exist
model_distribution: Opacity, scales and distance from inherited sparse-point centroid; not geometry accuracy
statistics: Scene-level direction and per-view distributions, no significance claims
